The building was reportedly erected on a cramped lot, and construction had previously ceased.

The original AIAPGET 2026 examination was conducted on August twenty-second across India. This re-examination ensures affected students receive a fair opportunity to complete their test.

Raj Kapoor was already a beloved figure due to earlier successful films.  The film resonated with audiences seeking dramatic and relatable entertainment.  This cinematic connection fostered a lasting cultural bridge between the nations.

A case was registered against her for alleged coercion and fraud in land purchase.  The high court dismissed Pachisia's petition, denying her interim relief.  Investigators found financial irregularities and pressure on the land seller.  The police department has adopted a strict legal stance against the accused officers.

title: 'Will not step down': Manan Mishra reiterates as plea in SC seeks his removal
description: "I have served as the Chairman of the Bar Council of India for 12 to 14 years because I was elected. Manan Mishra represents 25 lakh lawyers; he will not step down simply," Mishra said. The lawyers demanding his resignation also sought the implementation of an Advocate Protection Act and questioned the proposed increase in registration fees at State Bar Councils.

title: NBFCs stay on growth track as asset quality remains stable: Report

NBFC earnings showed strong growth in the first quarter of FY27. Vehicle financiers experienced accelerated asset under management growth. Gold financiers saw moderated growth and yield pressures.

title: Quote of the day by Susan Sarandon
description: Susan Sarandon, the esteemed actress, cherishes the process of getting older, viewing it as a valuable phase of life. She asserts that authentic beauty is derived from personal character and self-respect, rather than superficial looks. Challenging societal norms that highlight physical attractiveness, Sarandon promotes the idea of embracing aging as a natural and beautiful journey.

title: India’s submarine hunting fleet gets stronger with indigenous warship Mangrol
description: The Indian Navy proudly welcomes Mangrol, its third indigenous Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft. This state-of-the-art vessel is crucial for enhancing coastal defense and forms part of an ambitious program to build eight such ships. With cutting-edge torpedoes and sonar systems for threat detection, Mangrol is primed for underwater surveillance and anti-submarine missions, bolstering India's capacity in shallow-water warfare.

description: India returned to winning ways in the World Test Championship after a 165-run victory over Sri Lanka in the first Test at the Galle International Stadium on Wednesday. Four days after that win, the visitors will be back in action in Colombo for the second and final Test. India will be pleased with most aspects of their performance in Galle, but Kuldeep's form remains one of the major talking points.

description: A 15-year-old American student was injured in a Juhu hit-and-run incident. A speeding motorcyclist struck the teen while she crossed the road near Bhaidas Hall. She sustained a concussion, leg bruises, and a jaw injury from the collision. Police have registered a case and are actively searching for the fleeing motorcyclist. Activists noted the absence of speedbreakers due to Metro construction work.

title: 'My job is to win trophies, don't care about views or likes': Gambhir
description: India go into the second Test against Sri Lanka in Colombo with a 1-0 lead after their 165-run win in Galle. But the series has also kept the focus on a team that is trying to build a new Test side after the departure of some of its biggest names.

title: TikTok to pay $400 million in US child privacy settlement over alleged violations

The party passed a resolution to protect the honor and national character of the complete Vande Mataram. Union Home Minister Amit Shah also attacked the Congress Working Committee's resolution as anti-national.

title: When Sunita Ahuja opened up about her marriage to Govinda
description: In a reflective moment, Sunita Ahuja opened up about her enduring connection with Govinda, emphasizing both the struggles and the growth she experienced over the years. Despite facing emotional challenges, she discovered her own strength and identity. Ahuja acknowledged Govinda as her childhood love, hinting at themes of forgiveness, and described how their relationship blossomed into a frank friendship.

In response, council members are actively pursuing answers and have prepared a list of inquiries for the administration.

As job losses become more frequent, public concerns escalate, with many Americans fearing that AI will diminish economic prospects. In response, companies are now positioning workforce adjustments as a transformation of roles rather than outright job elimination.

description: Rahul Dravid advocates for a well-balanced strategy for aspiring cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. He points out the crucial role of red-ball cricket alongside white-ball fixtures in a player's development. Such diverse training is anticipated to aid Sooryavanshi's growth. Dravid encourages patience as the youngster starts his professional path, reaffirming the sport's dedication to cultivating future Test cricket players.

This situation has raised eyebrows about potential gender bias within the film industry. Fans have rallied behind Padukone on social media, while the role has now been taken over by Triptii Dimri for the project.

title: Kumar Sangakkara restores century-old Sri Lankan villa for a new chapter
description: Cricket icon Kumar Sangakkara and his wife have beautifully restored a historic villa within Galle Fort, blending 120 years of Sri Lankan history with a modern touch. The restoration process highlights weathered walls and rich layers of patina, giving the home a distinct character. Now a four-bedroom residence, it features lush courtyard gardens and a rooftop pool, allowing visitors to experience the captivating heritage of Galle Fort.

title: ‘Crushed his lungs’: How a ‘minor’ dispute ended in Adobe techie's death

The assault occurred at his home in Delhi after his wife summoned her family members.  Police have detained four individuals in connection with the brutal incident and are investigating.  The case is being registered under sections relating to murder and common intention.

Police have detained four individuals in connection with the incident.  The engineer and his wife had been married for three and a half years.  An investigation is underway to determine the exact circumstances of the assault.

title: Why Canada suspended US trade talks despite Trump's 'good relationship' with Carney

The rescue operation turned into a tragedy as the teenager remained determined. Fire brigade teams deployed safety nets, but efforts were complicated by his movements. Police are investigating the exact sequence of events leading to the deaths.

His son immediately took the injured woman to the hospital after the incident.  Three medical tests conducted on his son have reportedly returned negative results.  The family expressed condolences and faith in the legal process to reveal facts.

Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann and West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee also experienced similar rejections.  Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal and Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan were also denied foreign trip approvals.  These rejections highlight the MEA's role in granting political clearance for official visits.

title: Congress’s renewed youth outreach: How CJP has forced parties to course correct
description: Student protests at Jantar Mantar have prompted political parties to rethink their youth engagement strategies. The Congress party is now focusing on youth issues and expanding its outreach programs nationwide. Rahul Gandhi's recent actions highlight the party's renewed commitment to addressing student concerns. The Congress Working Committee has proposed an education-to-employment roadmap for young people. This shift reflects a broader effort to regain support among the nation's youth.
